declarations.name: FormFieldsetProgressElement
declarations.description: Enhances outermost fieldsets in one form into a light-DOM, validated step-by-step experience. Optional generated or referenced review adds a final fieldset with safe labeled values in a definition list. Progress is the current one-based section number out of the total, including review; a single-section form hides progress and its labels. Referenced enhancement-only controls are revealed when useful and authored visibility restores on teardown. With no control reference attributes, the full-width footer reserves equal Back/Next slots around progress and relocates authored enabled reset controls not hidden by a hidden attribute before Back. Review references do not customize this footer. With a generated Next button, enabled submit controls move to the footer; disabled submit controls stay where authored to preserve inherited disabled states.

attributes.name: review-panel
attributes.description: Generate a final review fieldset with dl > div > dt/dd entries from enabled named native fields. Mutually exclusive with review-ref. Omit passwords, hidden inputs and disabled controls; insert labels and values as plain text. Rebuild on entry.

attributes.name: review-ref
attributes.description: ID of an outermost read-only fieldset in the controlled form, with a direct nonempty legend and no hidden ancestor. Use it as the final review section and populate its first direct dl or generate one. Mutually exclusive with review-panel; does not customize footer placement. Restore authored nodes and visibility on teardown.

attributes.name: review-label
attributes.description: Nonempty literal generated review legend. An authored review uses its own legend. Changing review configuration restarts setup.

attributes.name: review-empty-label
attributes.description: Nonempty plain text for empty review values and unselected choice groups.

attributes.name: review-checked-label
attributes.description: Nonempty plain text for checked standalone checkboxes in review.

attributes.name: review-unchecked-label
attributes.description: Nonempty plain text for unchecked standalone checkboxes in review.

attributes.name: previous-ref
attributes.description: ID of a type=button previous button owned by the form.

attributes.name: next-ref
attributes.description: ID of a type=button next button owned by the form.

attributes.name: progress-ref
attributes.description: ID of an authored progress element.

attributes.name: progress-label-ref
attributes.description: ID of the progress text container. Otherwise reuse an associated label or generate one. Referenced and automatically selected labels must be outside all sections, including an authored review. A wrapping container may contain its controlled progress and a marked text span, but must not enclose the host, controlled form, other form controls or links.

attributes.name: previous-label
attributes.description: Short visible Back label; supports destination-template tokens.

attributes.name: next-label
attributes.description: Short visible Next label; supports destination-template tokens.

attributes.name: progress-label
attributes.description: Visible current-step template. Supports {current}, {total}, and {legend}, using the active fieldset's legend.

attributes.name: previous-aria-label
attributes.description: Distinct Back accessible-name template; visible wording is retained. No aria-label is emitted when the name matches the visible text. Without an override, visible templates containing {legend} use native button naming.

attributes.name: next-aria-label
attributes.description: Distinct Next accessible-name template; visible wording is retained. No aria-label is emitted when the name matches the visible text. Without an override, visible templates containing {legend} use native button naming.

attributes.name: progress-aria-label
attributes.description: Optional distinct progress accessible-name template. The default uses the visible label through native association or aria-labelledby, without duplicating its text in aria-label.

attributes.name: no-validation
attributes.description: Discouraged opt-out of forward-step validation; delays error feedback until submission. Final native validation remains enabled.

members.name: form
members.description: Controlled form while ready, otherwise null.

members.name: stepIndex
members.description: Zero-based active step, reset to 0 on teardown.

members.name: stepCount
members.description: Number of available steps, including optional final review.

members.name: refresh
members.description: Restore authored markup and reinitialize at the first step. Report setup failures through the error event.

members.name: next
members.description: Validate and advance, focusing the destination's first available input, select, or textarea, or its fieldset when none can receive focus. Return false at the boundary, before readiness, on validation failure, or when beforechange is canceled.

members.name: previous
members.description: Go back without validation, focusing the destination's first available input, select, or textarea, or its fieldset when none can receive focus. Return false at the boundary, before readiness, or when beforechange is canceled.

members.name: goTo
members.description: Navigate synchronously to a zero-based step, validating sections crossed forward and focusing the destination's first available input, select, or textarea, or its fieldset when none can receive focus. The active-step no-op does not move focus. Return false when beforechange is canceled. Throw RangeError for an unavailable index.

events.name: form-fieldset-progress:beforechange
events.description: Bubbling, cancelable navigation event after applicable validation and before rendering or focus changes. Detail describes the destination: stepIndex, stepCount, fieldset, and previousIndex. Cancellation returns false without navigating. Not emitted for setup, reset, invalid-field recovery, or requests for the active step.

events.name: form-fieldset-progress:ready
events.description: Bubbling event after successful setup; detail: stepIndex, stepCount, fieldset.

events.name: form-fieldset-progress:change
events.description: Bubbling event after a step changes; detail also includes previousIndex.

events.name: form-fieldset-progress:error
events.description: Bubbling setup failure event with detail.error; fallback markup is restored first.

cssProperties.name: --fieldset-progress-accent
cssProperties.description: Progress and primary navigation color; ensure contrast with HighlightText.

declarations.name: defineFormFieldsetProgress
declarations.description: Register the default tag on import. Imports are safe without DOM globals; return false when no browser registry is available. The helper is idempotent for the same class and tag; conflicting definitions throw. Registration declarations include the element tag and event mappings.
